turns.assessment: The alarms at t=602.5 describe a separate failure affecting the S07–S17/S24 optical area; svc071 does not use that route. Its first direct CLIENT_SF alarms are at t=795, amid a broad incident concentrated on services using S08. An S08 OTN switch failure could explain much of that service footprint, but unaffected services also traverse S08, while simultaneous OCH_LOS alarms imply optical failures that an OTN switch fault should not cause. The evidence therefore does not isolate one documented repair target to the required confidence.

proposals.rationale: Many services traversing or terminating at S08 fail together at t=795, including svc071, while protected services switch. However, unaffected services also traverse S08 and the numerous OCH_LOS alarms are inconsistent with a pure switch-fabric failure.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: A hard optical block at S08 could produce OCH_LOS and interrupt multiple services. A single documented WSS input-port failure, however, affects only one arriving degree and does not readily explain the multi-degree footprint.
